- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x0cp9tl3l", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "Emerging Market Industrial ETF can serve as a barometer for global liquidity conditions, reflecting investor sentiment, capital flows, economic growth expectations, credit conditions: During periods of ample liquidity, investors may be more willing to invest in riskier assets such as emerging market industrials, driving up the ETF's performance. Conversely, during periods of tight liquidity, investors may shy away from riskier assets, leading to underperformance of the ETF. 1- Capital Flows: Fluctuations in the assets under management (AUM) of the ETF can indicate capital flows into or out of emerging market industrials. Increased AUM may suggest growing investor interest and liquidity in the sector, while decreased AUM may indicate the opposite. 2- Economic Growth Expectations: The performance of industrial companies in emerging markets is closely tied to economic growth expectations. If the ETF performs well, it may suggest optimism about economic growth prospects in emerging markets, possibly driven by expectations of ample liquidity supporting investment and economic activity. 3- Credit Conditions: Liquidity in emerging market industrials can also be influenced by credit conditions. If liquidity is abundant, companies in the industrial sector may find it easier to access credit for expansion and investment, potentially leading to improved performance of the ETF.", "created": 1780965726023, "pinned": false, "source": "final financials book 2.docx"}

- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x0cp8fqj0", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "When retail is fully invested thats when market peaks bcs it just can't go up any further there is just NO NEW MONEY coming in, everybody is ALREADY fully invested. - `18:08:22` --- note 6018/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x0cp8o657", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "MArket Psychology: A lot of people have this notion that the moment retail returns its over and that's just the DUMBEST thing EVER bcs when retail is coming back thats causes a price SURGE bcs there is so much new money entering the market, the crowd is flooding, the prices are still UNDERVALUED and the prices are able to rise EXPONENTIALLY, PARABOLLY. Retail entering the market ISN'T a bad thing. That's pretty much how you make money in markets. Retail making NOISE ON SOCIAL MEDIA thats what DRIVE the overvaluation of the market and that's how people MAKE MONEY. YOU HAVE TO BE VERY CAREFUL WHEN RETAIL IS FULLY INVESTED, WHEN THE CROWD IS BULLISH BCS THE MARKET IS OVERVALUED.", "created": 1780965725871, "pinned": false, "source": "final financials book 2.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6019/12122 >>> MACRO/RISK-RELEVANT <<< ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x0cp82a5i", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "When Gov can't borrow at long term: 10, 20, 30 years either due to low liquidity (low bid to cover ratio, High Alloted at High %, High tail) they borrow at short term: 2 years or less. This is bcs when they borrow at the short end of the curve it pulls cash out of the Reverse Repo facility. So for ex: if Reverse Repo facility have $1 Trillion left, the US gov can borrow roughly $1 Trillion more at the short end of the curve and they dont have to worry about it pushing yields much higher this is bcs the money inside the Reverse Repo facility is currently getting paid 5.3% so anytime the gov borrows at the short end of the curve around 5.5% that's better than the 5.3% the money is getting in Reverse Repo facility so it pulls Money out of there as that cash seeks the higher yield. It's important to note that this doesn't happen for long term debt bcs any of those dollars in the reverse repo are there for liquidity needs, that is short-term cash so none of that money can be nor wants to be locked up in long term debt. WHEN THE MONEY IN THE REVERSE REPO FACILITY DRIES UP AND HIT 0 THAT'S WHEN SHIT HIT THE FAN.", "created": 1780965725870, "pinned": false, "source": "final financials book 2.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6020/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x0cp8k6rq", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "bid to cover ratio: The difference between the numbers of dollars there are that the gov could borrow and the number of dollars is actually trying to borrow on that day.", "created": 1780965725869, "pinned": false, "source": "final financials book 2.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6021/12122 >>> MACRO/RISK-RELEVANT <<< ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x0cp851cm", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "Allotted at High % usually is about 32%. In September 11, 2008 it was 82.6% . the global financial crisis hit one week later. Another important metric for liquidity is the Bid to Cover Ratio, the higher the bid to cover ratio the more liquidity and vice versa. (September 15, 2008 financial crisis happened the same day of the issue date of the treasuries, we can find both metrics in the treasury auctions results). If we ever see a tail in the 4, 5, or 6bp range (0.4%, 0.5%, 0.6% , this would be considered disastrous in the bond world and mean things are breaking in US Treasuries.", "created": 1780965725868, "pinned": false, "source": "final financials book 2.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6022/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x0cp8a2bt", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "When high yields is a lot less than interest rates and the allotted at high percentage is very high. that signals a collateral shortage and a financial crisis ALWAYS happen within days if not hours.", "created": 1780965725867, "pinned": false, "source": "final financials book 2.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6023/12122 >>> MACRO/RISK-RELEVANT <<< ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x0cp88rx3", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "One of the most important metric for liquidity that warns us about financial crisis and global liquidity crisis is : \"allotted at High %\", \"comparing high yield to interest rate\" and \"Bid to Cover Ratio\" in Treasury auctions.", "created": 1780965725866, "pinned": false, "source": "final financials book 2.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6024/12122 >>> MACRO/RISK-RELEVANT <<< ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x0cp8s1qn", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "How can Treasury auctions warn us about LOW liquidity (LIQUIDITY DRYING UP), black swan events and Finaancial crisis? Treasury Auctions have warned us about black swans and financial crisis EVERY SINGLE TIME.", "created": 1780965725865, "pinned": false, "source": "final financials book 2.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6025/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x0cp8pnm4", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "Well why would we see a long tail basically the gov paying so much more as intrest rate for the treasury debt they auctioning off than what they originally wanted? When there are A LOT fewer dollars available for them to borrow from than Normal. Basically a Low Bid to cover ratio (One thats below 2) February 15,2018 treasury auction Bid to cover ratio was 1.79", "created": 1780965725864, "pinned": false, "source": "final financials book 2.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6026/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x0cp8rskg", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "When there is less dollars available for the treasury to borrow from than there normally are (lower bid to cover ratio) the ALLOTTED AT HIGH % and when that means the treasury (gov) are left paying a much higher rate than they normally have to pay relative to what they originally asked for.", "created": 1780965725863, "pinned": false, "source": "final financials book 2.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6027/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x0cp8hqok", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "2- A High allotted at High % ( September 11,2008 10 year auction allotted at high % was 82.6% and tail was 40 basis points 0.4%), (March 11, 2020 10 year auction Allotted at high was 74.94% and tail was 40 beeps or 0.4% ). So Both 2008 and 2020 black swans had a very high alloted at high % (double what it would be in Normal times 82% and 74% vs 32% in Normal times ) and a tail that's 20 times higher what it would be in normal times (40 beeps 0.4% vs 1 or 2 beeps 0.01% or 0.02% in normal times). A high Allotted at high % also marked EVERY crypto TOP ( November 8 2017 94.01% and 60.17% October 12,2021).", "created": 1780965725862, "pinned": false, "source": "final financials book 2.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6028/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x0cp81y9n", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "So if we ever see a tail in the 4, 5, or 6bp range (0.4%, 0.5%, 0.6% , this would be considered disastrous in the bond world and mean things are breaking up in US Treasuries.", "created": 1780965725861, "pinned": false, "source": "final financials book 2.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6029/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x0cp8yd48", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "What's considered NOT NORMAL in a treasury auction? 1- A Long tail: simply visualizing what the difference is between what the gov wanted to borrow their debt at and what the ended up having to pay for ex: if they wanted to borrow at 5% and ended up paying 5.02% , The tail or the difference is 2 basis points 0.02%. Usually the tail or the difference doesn't dip below 1 basis points or 0.01% but every once is a while it dips below 2 basis points 0.02%.", "created": 1780965725860, "pinned": false, "source": "final financials book 2.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6030/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x0cp8d8s0", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "What's considered a Normal Treasury auction? Two conditions have to be met for a treasury auction to be considered Normal: First: Bid to cover ratio ABOVE 2. Second: The high yield or the rate that the gov ends up actually paying is pretty close to what they started off with. For ex: if they say we are going to acution off a Billion dollars worth of debt at 5% then maybe they end up paying 5.01% or 5.02% so they pay very close to what they want to pay.", "created": 1780965725859, "pinned": false, "source": "final financials book 2.docx"}

- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x0cp8i1hb", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "How do Fed hiking interest rates shrinks global credit and global liquidity? when fed hike rates, treasury bond value drops. Since treasuries are used as a collateral for derivatives and global credit when their value drop that means the amount of derivatives and credit that can be obtained through them will also drops which shrinks global credit and liquidity. Same concept works in reverse, FED cutting rates will increase treasury bond value which will increase the amount of credit and liquidity that can be obtained by using them as collateral.", "created": 1780965725852, "pinned": false, "source": "final financials book 2.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6037/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x0cp84h6m", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "Why United States leading economic index is the SINGLE BEST Barometer to gauge the ENIRE MARKET? The composite leading indicator (CLI) , (OECD)is designed to provide early signals of turning points in business cycles . It shows Start of Recessions and economic boom at a very early stage. it has 10 subcomponents which feeds into it: yield curve, ism index of new orders, man new orders, stock prices, leading credit index, interest rate spread: 10-year treasury bonds less federal funds rate, weekly initial claims of unemployment, building permits, avg consumer expectations for business conditions, average weekly hours in manufacturing. It's published by the conference board and u can find it on their website. yield curve: 10-year treasury yields minus the federal funds rate.", "created": 1780965725851, "pinned": false, "source": "final financials book 2.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6038/12122  ---

- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x0cp89d64", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "Whats behind the curtain, the plumbing of the financial system? Dollar shortage, scramble for collateral which leads to deleveraging. Bcs if i can't get collateral I got to take the trade off, deleveraging of balance sheet, etc which are the early warning signs of a global financial panic and a likely recession. We could very well be looking at a severe recession and a global liquidity crisis. Two different thing, but they could converge.", "created": 1780965725841, "pinned": false, "source": "final financials book 2.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6045/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x0cp8oiqn", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "Treasury yield curve is a short term bet on a long term rate. Yield curve should be upward sloping just bcs time value of money and uncertainty, etc. If i lend for a longer period of time or make a further forward bet I should get a higher rate. Well how come people betting on overnight rates a year or two years from now think that rates are going to be lower? And that shouldn't happen. The only explanation for that is we're going to get into recession, It's going to get a lot worse.", "created": 1780965725840, "pinned": false, "source": "final financials book 2.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6046/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x0cp80b1v", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "The Eurodollar futures curve is a long term bet on a short term rate bcs the Eurodollar future is it's like we are betting on what an overnight rate is going to be two years from now.", "created": 1780965725839, "pinned": false, "source": "final financials book 2.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6047/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x0cp8h0tk", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "Treasuries supply plays a role in collateral sufficiency but whats as important if not even more important than treasuries supply is the collateral multiplier: its the velocity, the reuse and repledging of the treasuries. How often a security is reused is a measure of sufficiency and fluidity, it's a measure of how the Eurodollar system is functioning wether it's functioning well or poorly bcs if the velocity of the collateral slows down (dealers dont repledge and reuse at the same rate they did before) the entire monetary system itself slows down.", "created": 1780965725838, "pinned": false, "source": "final financials book 2.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6048/12122 >>> MACRO/RISK-RELEVANT <<< ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x0cp882x8", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "Inverted yield curve, big deal. The yield on a one year bill is higher than a 10 year treasury note. Okay so if i lend u money for a year i might want a certain interest rate, but if im gonna lend you money for 10 years i would want a higher interest rate bcs there's more risk, inflation, credit risk, etc. So why is the yield on that 10 year note lower than the one year bill, it makes no sense except unless you think smthg bad is gonna happen like a really bad recession then that yield on that 10 year note looks really good bcs you are gonna have huge capital gains when that yield actually collapses. The Fed can control the very short end of the yield curve but they can't control the 5 year notes, 10 year notes, let alone the 30 year bonds. So an inverted yield curve is telling you smthg really bad is gonna happen other wise those long term bond yields wouldnt be lower.", "created": 1780965725837, "pinned": false, "source": "final financials book 2.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6049/12122  ---

- `18:08:22` --- note 6050/12122  ---

- `18:08:22` --- note 6051/12122  ---

- `18:08:22` --- note 6161/12122  ---

- `18:08:22` --- note 6162/12122 >>> MACRO/RISK-RELEVANT <<< ---

- `18:08:22` --- note 6163/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x0cp7l5up", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "A rising yield is dollar bullish. A falling yield is dollar bearish: For example, in the U.S., you would focus on the 10-year Treasury note.", "created": 1780965725670, "pinned": false, "source": "final financials book 2.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6164/12122 >>> MACRO/RISK-RELEVANT <<< ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x0cp6d7tc", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "Spreads between Rates is the perfect measure for Liquidity. - `18:08:22` --- note 6165/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x0cp6nfc6", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "What determines Dollar strength or weakness is: Interest rate differential between the US and the Rest of the World (especially Europe and Japan), Economic Growth differential between the US and the Rest of the World ( Especially Europe and japan), and its safe Haven status especially in economic crisis and wars.", "created": 1780965725666, "pinned": false, "source": "final financials book 2.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6166/12122 >>> MACRO/RISK-RELEVANT <<< ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x0cp622v3", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "THE BIGGEST CARRY TRADE CURRENCY IS THE DOLLAR, THERE IS MORE MONEY BORROWED IN DOLLAR BY FAR THAN ANY OTHER CURRENCY. SO FED AND JAPAN RAISE RATES TOO MUCH CAUSING DOLLAR AND YEN TO STRENGTHEN THEREFORE UNWINDING ALL THE DOLLAR ALONG YEN CARRY TRADE POSITIONS WOULD BE JUST DEVESTATING FOR GLOBAL LIQUIDITY AND GLOBAL MARKETS.", "created": 1780965725661, "pinned": false, "source": "final financials book 2.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6167/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x0cp66qv0", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "FED RAISING RATES TO STRENGTHEN THE DOLLAR IS JUST HELL FOR THE REST OF THE WORLD BCS MANY PEOPLE AROUND THE WORLD FUND THEMSELVES WITH DOLLARS AND ALL THE DEBT THEY OWE IS IN DOLLAR SO THE FED RAISING RATES AND THE US DOLLAR STRENGTHENING WOULD JUST BE HELL FOR THE REST OF THE WORLD.", "created": 1780965725660, "pinned": false, "source": "final financials book 2.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6168/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x0cp6hod7", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "Global Copper price has an inverse correlation to DXY on \"M\" when copper Tops that's the bottom for DXY and when copper bottoms that's the top for DXY.", "created": 1780965725659, "pinned": false, "source": "final financials book 2.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6169/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x0cp67fwq", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "A High DXY is a sign of very tight USA and Global financial conditions, a Low DXY is a sign of very loose USA and Global financial conditions.", "created": 1780965725656, "pinned": false, "source": "final financials book 2.docx"}

- `18:08:22` --- note 6171/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x0cp6uxt5", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "A Spike in DXY Along a DUMP in OIL , a DUMP in US02Y and other yields (bcs investors are flying to bonds for safety)and Global price index of ALL Commodities ( and maybe a DUMP of EU02Y and Germany 02 yield) is a CLEAR SIGN of a GLOBAL FINANCIAL CRISIS.", "created": 1780965725653, "pinned": false, "source": "final financials book 2.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6172/12122 >>> MACRO/RISK-RELEVANT <<< ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x0cp6zv9s", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "FED injects Liquidity in the system through REPO and Swaps (that's how it gives Dollars to foreign banks and govs) and drains cash from the market through Reverse REPO.", "created": 1780965725652, "pinned": false, "source": "final financials book 2.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6173/12122 >>> MACRO/RISK-RELEVANT <<< ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x0cp6jp2t", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "Global Liquidity drainage shows in Pacific and Africa first, then Emerging Markets small cap second, Then Developed markets third. then USA micro cap 4th, the SPX last. Rest of World Always Dumps before USA.", "created": 1780965725651, "pinned": false, "source": "final financials book 2.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6174/12122 >>> MACRO/RISK-RELEVANT <<< ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x0cp65fwx", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "A Dollar shortage (which will cause Collateral shortage in EuroDollar and Eurodollar Interest Rates to spike), along expensive Oil and energy prices accompanied by a slow Global Growth And a Weak yen (which will force exporter countries to devalue their local currency to be able to compete with chinese exports) is THE WORST Lethal situation for the Rest of the World to be in.", "created": 1780965725650, "pinned": false, "source": "final financials book 2.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6175/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x0cp6wktf", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "THERE IS A HUGE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN USING THE US DOLLAR AS A SWORD OR AS A SHIELD, THE US DOLLAR WEAPONIZE THE DOLLAR AND USING IT AS A SWORD WHILE THE REST OF THE WORLD TRYING TO GET PROTECTED FROM ITS SWINGS AND USE IT AS A SHIELD.", "created": 1780965725649, "pinned": false, "source": "final financials book 2.docx"}

- `18:08:22` --- note 6177/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x0cp62huw", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "Total 3: Altcoins market cap.", "created": 1780965725647, "pinned": false, "source": "final financials book 2.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6178/12122 >>> MACRO/RISK-RELEVANT <<< ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x0cp65q0n", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "Brent johnson measure liquidity through Credit spreads. Narrow credit spreads means risky companies dont have to pay that much more than a treasury to get funded or service their debt. Narrow spread shows there is liquidity in the market , that shows there is enough liquidity in the market that people are willing to fund these risky businesses at a slightly higher interest rates than treasuries.", "created": 1780965725646, "pinned": false, "source": "final financials book 2.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6179/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x0cp60oqh", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "The US is always the last country to go into recession and its stock market is always the last one to dump. So You should watch ROW economies to predict a US recession and ROW stock market crash to predict a US stock market crash.", "created": 1780965725645, "pinned": false, "source": "final financials book 2.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6180/12122 >>> MACRO/RISK-RELEVANT <<< ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x0cp6zuxx", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "The areas of the world that are able to draw capital and liquify their markets are gonna do well and the ones who cant attract liquidity are gonna do poorly.", "created": 1780965725644, "pinned": false, "source": "final financials book 2.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6181/12122 >>> MACRO/RISK-RELEVANT <<< ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x0cp6kvux", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "The most important thing for All markets including the stock market is liquidity Not earnings nor multiple not that earnings or multiples aren\u2019t important but Liquidity is a lot more important. Even if the US raises rates as long as markets stay liquid where credit spreads still narrow the markets are gonna do well If markets are liquid and people are able to borrow and able to fund businesses.", "created": 1780965725643, "pinned": false, "source": "final financials book 2.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6182/12122 >>> MACRO/RISK-RELEVANT <<< ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x0cp68vx0", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "Recession comes 3 to 18 months after yield curve inversion. But what they dont tell you until the recession comes. Equities go higher Every single time. So the idea that yield curve inverts so you should automatically go sell your risk asset (bcs the inversion means a recession is coming within a very short period of time) has been historically disproven WRONG.", "created": 1780965725642, "pinned": false, "source": "final financials book 2.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6183/12122 >>> MACRO/RISK-RELEVANT <<< ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x0cp60dwe", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "Money and Liquidity comes either from the Fed or Commercial Banks. When Net Percentage of banks Tightening standards for small firms goes up Commercial banks are tightening, they draining liquidity from the system. when Net Percentage of banks Tightening standards for small firms comes down Commercial banks are easing they injecting liquidity into the markets.", "created": 1780965725641, "pinned": false, "source": "final financials book 2.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6184/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x0cp690ou", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "The 2 biggest components of Credit Market are: 1- Gov credit Market (controlled through interest rate policies, treasuries issuance, QE and QT and swaps). 2- private Equity credit market (can be seen through % of banks tightening, ice BOFA CCC interest rate spread).", "created": 1780965725640, "pinned": false, "source": "final financials book 2.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6185/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x0cp6p5u9", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "When interest Rate rise in the United States that make the Dollar stronger bcs global investors already have to own the dollar anyway to operate on the global stage and to conduct global commerce transactions so if they paid a higher interest rate to save your money in Dollars it just makes the Dollar even more turbocharged.", "created": 1780965725639, "pinned": false, "source": "final financials book 2.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6186/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x0cp6jpqu", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "Rate hikes hit the Economy with a lag of 6 to 8 months.", "created": 1780965725638, "pinned": false, "source": "final financials book 2.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6187/12122 >>> MACRO/RISK-RELEVANT <<< ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x0cp64lml", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "Part of the way u slow the market in you are a central banker is you contract credit bcs credit creates money, the more credit thats created the more liquidity there is the more growth and the more speculation in risk assets, so if you want to contract the economy and stop nonsense speculation in Risk assets you contract credit which will contracts the amount of liquidity and money in the system.", "created": 1780965725637, "pinned": false, "source": "final financials book 2.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6188/12122 >>> MACRO/RISK-RELEVANT <<< ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x0cp6xhpc", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "When FED start with raising rates and QT they wanna slow the economy down (to ease inflation) or they wanna bring pain to bring sense to the market (to stop just pure speculation in risk assets) but they dont wanna implode the system.", "created": 1780965725636, "pinned": false, "source": "final financials book 2.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6189/12122 >>> MACRO/RISK-RELEVANT <<< ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x0cp66zlc", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "What would make the fed pivot is a problem in the funding market: treasury auctions, collateral agreements, reverse repo, or a consistent Mega Dump in the stock Market for few days.", "created": 1780965725635, "pinned": false, "source": "final financials book 2.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6190/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x0cp6y3jt", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "Economy Crash lags yield curve inversion by 30 months, Stock Pumps and SPX hits new highs during the last phase of the inversion before a MEGA Crash and DUMP occur.", "created": 1780965725634, "pinned": false, "source": "final financials book 2.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6191/12122 >>> MACRO/RISK-RELEVANT <<< ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x0cp6i0gs", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "Its Best for Risk Asset to see a Sudden Huge Dump that happens in one time just like 2020 or 2008 than a slow bleed. A huge dump force the FED to intervene and inject liquidity.", "created": 1780965725633, "pinned": false, "source": "final financials book 2.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6192/12122 >>> MACRO/RISK-RELEVANT <<< ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x0cp61xq5", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "The FED is a REACTIONARY organization and NOT an anticipatory org. A crash and some major event have to happen in the markets for them to intervene with rate cuts and liquidity injection, unless that happens they wont intervene.", "created": 1780965725632, "pinned": false, "source": "final financials book 2.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6193/12122 >>> MACRO/RISK-RELEVANT <<< ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x0cp654gr", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "Swaps and QE increase liquidity and dollar supply therefore cause DXY to Dump, QT shrink liquidity and Dollar supply causing DXY to Pump.", "created": 1780965725630, "pinned": false, "source": "final financials book 2.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6194/12122 >>> MACRO/RISK-RELEVANT <<< ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x0cp66coa", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "FED filling up (TGA Treasury General Account) is a net drain for liquidity (it sucks liquidity out of the system bcs FED give investors treasuries and get Dollars). As TGA Pumps Liquidity Dumps.", "created": 1780965725629, "pinned": false, "source": "final financials book 2.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6195/12122 >>> MACRO/RISK-RELEVANT <<< ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x0cp6sagi", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "FED uses REPO, SWAPS , interest rate cuts, increase Bank Reserves to pump liquidity into the system and raise interest rates, Reverse Repo and Treasury General Account, shrink Bank Reserves to drain liquidity from the system.", "created": 1780965725628, "pinned": false, "source": "final financials book 2.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6196/12122 >>> MACRO/RISK-RELEVANT <<< ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x0cp645pk", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "FED controls liquidity through Treasuries Held Outright , REPO, SWAPS , Reverse Repo and Treasury General Account and interest Rates.", "created": 1780965725627, "pinned": false, "source": "final financials book 2.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6197/12122 >>> MACRO/RISK-RELEVANT <<< ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x0cp6m4jj", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "Crypto and Risk Assets are directly tied to Liquidity. When there is plenty of liquidity they Pump , when liquidity JUST starts to drain (just the start of the drain) crypto and Risk Assets DUMP.", "created": 1780965725626, "pinned": false, "source": "final financials book 2.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6198/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x0cp6dxy1", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "When financial markets Dumps it always happen to be in the fall.", "created": 1780965725625, "pinned": false, "source": "final financials book 2.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6199/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x0cp605r4", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "Financial markets are a leading indicators they predict the economy and not vice versa.", "created": 1780965725624, "pinned": false, "source": "final financials book 2.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6200/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x0cp6suwr", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "There is No way the US treasury Dept wont be able to fund itself through selling treasuries but the ECB or BOJ or bank of PBOC can fund themselves by selling their gov bonds.", "created": 1780965725622, "pinned": false, "source": "final financials book 2.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6201/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x0cp6vl2l", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "As Treasury Bond price fall that means there is less capacity to loan bcs there wouldnt be as much collateral in the system.", "created": 1780965725621, "pinned": false, "source": "final financials book 2.docx"}

- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x0cp6ryat", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "Global Liquidity drainage shows in Pacific and Africa first, then Emerging Markets small cap second, Then Developed markets third. then USA micro cap 4th, then SPX last. Rest of World Always Dumps before USA.", "created": 1780965725620, "pinned": false, "source": "final financials book 2.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6203/12122 >>> MACRO/RISK-RELEVANT <<< ---

- `18:08:22` --- note 6267/12122 >>> MACRO/RISK-RELEVANT <<< ---

- `18:08:22` --- note 6303/12122 >>> MACRO/RISK-RELEVANT <<< ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00zigp2r", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "FUNDAMENTAL ANALYSIS IS IMPORTANT, TECHNICAL ANALYSIS IS IMPORTANT AND ECONOMIC ANALYSIS IS IMPORTANT. THESE ARE THREE DISCIPLINES INVOLVED IN INVESTING AND YOU NEED ALL THREE TO BE A SUCCESSFUL INVESTOR. TECHNICAL ANALYSIS IS THE EASIEST OUT OF THE 3 FOR NEWBIES AND YOU CAN HAVE SOME SUCCESS WITH IT IN THE SHORT TERM, IF YOU ARE DAY TRADING YOU MIGHT NOT NEED MORE THAN TECHNICAL ANALYSIS BUT IF YOU ARE A MORE SERIOUS INVESTOR OVER TIME YOU'RE GOING TO NEED TO LEARN HOW COMPANIES WORK WHETHER YOU'RE TRADING OPTIONS OR EQUITY, YOU NEED TO LEARN IF A COMPANY IS RUNNING SALES GROWTH, THE CASH FLOW, THE BALANCE SHEET YOU WANNA SEE. SO YOU HAVE TO KNOW YOUR WAY AROUND FUNDAMENTAL ANALYSIS BUT YOU ALSO HAVE TO KNOW YOUR WAY AROUND ECONOMICS. YOU HAVE TO BE ABLE TO FRONT RUN POLICY, YOU HAVE TO THINK AHEAD OF CENTRAL BANKERS AND LEGISLATORS. SO YOU NEED TO UNDERSTAND WHICH DIRECTION DO YOU THINK THE MACRO IS GOING BCS THAT GIVES YOU A LEG UP ON THE POLICYMAKERS BCS THEY'RE ALMOST HISTORICALLY SLOW TO ACT. THINK OF THE MARKET AS A BUS: THE MACRO ECONOMIC ANALYSIS IS THE DIRECTION THE BUS WILL MOVE BCS THAT CREATES POLICY SO THE BUS IS EITHER GONNA MOVE NORTH OR SOUTH (IT'S A NORTH OR SOUTH ROAD) THEN WE MOVE ON TO FUNDAMENTAL ANALYSIS THIS TELLS YOU WHETHER THE STOCK YOU'RE PICKING IS IN SHAPE TO KEEP UP WITH THE MARKET TREND SO IS IT GONNA KEEP UP WITH THE OTHER BUSES ON THE HIGHWAY THAT'S FUNDAMENTAL ANALYSIS, TECHNICAL ANALYSIS TELLS YOU WHERE THE BUS STOPS ARE , IT TELLS YOU WHAT PRICE LEVELS ARE LIKELY TO MEET MORE RESISTENCE OR MORE SUPPORT, LESS RESISTENCE LESS SUPPORT IT GIVES YOU A BETTER IDEA WHERE THIS BUS IS GOING TO PULL OVER, WHERE IT MIGHT MAKE A U TURN, THOSE TYPE OF THINGS.", "created": 1780965710971, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6304/12122 >>> MACRO/RISK-RELEVANT <<< ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00zi7py1", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "Buying options comes with the downside risk to the premium that you paid you might lose that money but when you are selling calls or puts and you dont have any equity position against that, that is what we call naked selling. Naked selling of calls or puts there's almost infinite risk on this bcs if it gets you the wrong way it can go all the way up to 0 zero, it can go all the way up to infinity on the upside. you can get hurt either way if you're selling calls or puts without any kind of equity positions against it. SO OVIOUSLY THAT'S NOT SMTHG YOU WANT , YOU DONT WANT ANYBODY WHO'S JUST LEARNING ABOUT OPTIONS WHO'S JUST STARTING TO GET IN THE GAME TO DO THAT. IT'S BEST FOR NEW PEOPLE BUYING THAN SELLING OPTIONS BCS SELLING IS SCARIER THAN BUYING, BEING SHORT IS SCARIER THAN BEING LONG SO IT'S BEST TO START WITH BUYING A CALL IN A STOCK THAT YOU ARE COMFORTABLE WITH, YOU DONT HAVE TO HAVE AN UNDERLYING POSITION IF YOU JUST BUY A CALL BCS THE ONLY DOWNSIDE RISK IS THE PREMIUM PAID. AND YOU CAN TURN THAT INTO A SPREAD WHICH FURTHER DECREASES THE RISK BUT AT THE EXPENSE OF CAPPING PROFITABILITY.", "created": 1780965710970, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6305/12122 >>> MACRO/RISK-RELEVANT <<< ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00zi5pf3", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "COVERED CALL: it's probably the closes thing to riskless in the finance universe. A covered call is simply the sale of a call in a stock or underlying security where you already own 100 shares of that stock bcs one options contract is worth 100 shares. So if you own 100 shares of a stock and you sell one options contract against that position for a premium, if it works over time you can consistently roll it over it will drive down your net basis or what people call your average price for that stock over time before it takes off and ventually gets to your strike price or your target price. Now if it goes above the stike price, it's called a call bcs those shares can be called away from you by the other side of the options trade. So if you bought the stock shares at 95 and you sold a covered call at $100 with a $100 strike price and it goes up to $105 you are still selling it at $100, the other side of the options trader gets the rest of that profit BUT YOU STILL GOT YOUR TARGET PRICE. SO THE ONLY RISK IS THAT YOU ARE MISSING ON THE POTENTIAL UPSIDE. YOU JUST HAVE OPPORTUNITY RISK, THE COVERED CALL OPTIONS IS NO RISK TO YOUR PRINCIPAL. YOU STILL HAVE EQUITY RISK (YOU STILL HAVE THE DOWN SIDE RISK OF THAT STOCK GOING DOWN) BUT THE COVERED CALL OPTION ITSELF DOESN'T CREATE ANY INCREASED RISK TO YOUR PRINCIPAL.", "created": 1780965710969, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6306/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00zijdt6", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "OPTIONS ARE JUST A RIGHT. IT'S A RIGHT TO BUY OR SELL A STOCK OR ANY UNDERLYING SECURITY AT A CERTAIN STRIKE PRICE BY A CERTAIN EXPIRATION DATE.", "created": 1780965710968, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6307/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00zizb9n", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "1- THE 1997-1998 CRISIS: it came ti a head in september 1998 with long term capital management in the Russian Default but it started in Thailand in June 1997 when they closed the capital account and devalued the Thai Baht and that started a panic throught Asia bcs everyone assumed that all these currencies pegged to the dollars were safe and you could put dollars into Thailand and Indonesia and so forth and not have to worry about the exchange rate and all the sudden there was a run on the bank. Once thailand did that there was a sequential collapse bank run in Indonesia, South Korea, Malaysia, etc throughtout southeast asia. IT WAS VERY SERIOUS IN THE FALL BUT THEN IT CALMED DOWN IN THE WINTER BY DECEMBER. BY DECEMBER 97 AND JANUARY 98, FEBRUARY 98 IT HAD DIED DOWN IT LOOKED LIKE IT WAS OVER. MOST WALL STREET HEDGE FUNDS WERENT WORRIED ABOUT IT BY FEBRUARY 98 THEY WERE EVEN LOOKING INTO EXPANDING THEIR BUSINESS IN ASIA. CAPITAL MANAGEMENT EVEN PAID A $3 BILLION ALL CASH DIVIDEND IN DECEMBER 97. THEY WERE SO CONFIDENT THAT THEY GAVE $3 BILLION BACK TO THEIR INVESTORS BUT THEN BY APRIL IT STARTED TO HOT UP AGAIN AND THE RUSSIAN DEFAULT WAS IN AUGUST 1998 AND LTCN MELTDOWN WAS IN SEPTEMBER. SO THAT HAD 2 STAGES BUT A QUIET PERIOD IN BETWEEN. SAME THING IN 2007 -2008 THE GLOBAL FINANCIAL CRISIS THAT REALLY TOOK OFF IN THE SPRING OF 2007 WITH MORTGAGES LOSSES BUT THEN IT DIED DOWN IN THE WINTER BUT THEM IT CAME BACK WITH BEAR STERNS SO THESE THINGS HAVE TWO STAGES, ALWAYS HAVE THE QUIET STAGE BUT THEN EVENTUALLY THE CRISIS RETURNS.", "created": 1780965710967, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6308/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00zivhrm", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "THE KEY TO BRICS ( OR ANY CURRENCY EVEN CRYPTO) IS EXPANDING THE MEMBERSHIP SO THAT THE CURRENCY IS WORTH SMTHG BCS MEMBERS CAN SPEND IT AMONG THEM AND NOW YOU CAN SPEND IT IN MORE THAN ONE PLACE.", "created": 1780965710964, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6309/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00zijidq", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "UNEMPLOYMENT IS A LAGGER INDICATOR BCS EMPLOYERS DO EVERYTHING POSSIBLE TO LAY PEOPLE OFF. WHEN REVENUES ARE DRYING UP AND MARGINS ARE GOING DOWN AND PROFITS ARE GOING DOWN. THEY WILL TURN OUT THE LIGHTS, THEY WILL RENEGOTIATE THE LEASE, CUT ON ADVERTISING, BARGAIN HARDER WITH SUPPLIERS. THEY WILL DO EVERYTHING THEY CAN EXCEPT FIRE PEOPLE BCS PEOPLE ARE HARD TO HIRE. YOU GET THE TALENT IT'S HARD TO FIND, AND YOU TRAIN SO THE LAST THING YOU WANT IS TO FIRE THEM. SO THEY WILL ONLY FIRE THEM WHEN THEY GET DESPERATE ENOUGH.", "created": 1780965710963, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6310/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00ziercf", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "PHILIPS CURVE IS AN INVERSE RELATION BETWEEN INFLATION AND UNEMPLOYMENT. - `18:08:22` --- note 6311/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00ziocnr", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "TERMINAL RATE IS THE RATE WHERE IT'S HIGH ENOUGH TO BRING INFLATION DOWN WITHOUT HAVING TO RAISE RATES MORE. IN OTHER WORDS RATES ARE HIGH ENOUGH TO ACT AS A BREAK JUST GIVE IT TIME AND INFLATION WILL COME DOWN ON ITS OWN WITHOUT FURTHER RATE HIKES.", "created": 1780965710961, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6312/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00ziibss", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "DOLLAR GOING UP WHILE BOND YIELDS GOING DOWN IS NOT A GOOD COMBINATION IT TELLS US THAT SMTHG IS GOING ON IN THE GLOBAL FINANCIAL SYSTEM AS A REFLECTION OF ECONOMIC FUNDAMENTALS AS WELL AS MONETARY CIRCUMSTANCES.", "created": 1780965710956, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6313/12122  ---

- `18:08:22` --- note 6314/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00zi9xtm", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "CERTAIN DERIVATIVES LIKE CREDIT DEFAULT SWAPS AND KNOCKOUT OPTIONS ARE PARTICULARLY PRONE TO CREATE HIDDEN IMBALANCES.", "created": 1780965710952, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6315/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00zidinu", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "BOOM BUST BUBBLES THEORY GEORGE SOROS: EVERY BUBBLE HAS TWO COMPONENTS: AN UNDERLYING TREND THAT PREVAILS IN REALITY AND A MISCONCEPTION RELATING TO THAT TREND. A BOOM BUST PROCESS IS SET IN MOTION WHEN A TREND AND A MISCONCEPTION POSITIVELY REINFORCE EACH OTHER. THE PROCESS IS LIABLE TO BE TESTED BY NEGATIVE FEEDBACK ALONG THE WAY, IF THE TREND IS STRONG ENOUGH TO SURVIVE THE TEST THEN BOTH THE TREND AND THE MISCONCEPTION WILL BE FURTHER REINFORCED. EVENTUALLY MARKET EXPECTATIONS BECOME SO FAR REMOVED FROM REALITY THAT PEOPLE ARE FORCED TO RECOGNIZE THAT THE MISCONCEPTION IS INVOLVED. A TWILIGHT PERIOD ISSUES DURING WHICH DOUBTS GROW AND MORE PEOPLE LOSE FAITH BUT THE PREVAILING TREND IS SUSTAINED BY INERTIA: \"WE MUST CONTINUE DANCING UNTIL THE MUSIC STOPS\". EVENTUALLY A POINT IS REACHED WHEN THE TREND IS REVERSED IT THEN BECOMES SELF-REINFORCING IN THE OPPOSITE DIRECTION.", "created": 1780965710951, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6316/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00zisi46", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "Finance ministry = the treasury department that do things about the level of the dollar and the dollar supply. The fed Jerome Powell doesn't manage the level or supply of the dollar.", "created": 1780965710949, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}

- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00zie9wu", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "GREED AND OPTIMISM CANNOT CONTINUE TO INFINITY, IT CAN NOT DEVIATE FOREVER FROM THE SECULAR TREND. SO EM DEPRECIATING THEIR LOCAL CURRENCY GIVES THE EQUILIBRIUM OF LOCAL MANUFACTURING PRODUCING MORE SINCE THE DEPRECIATION OF THE LOCAL CURRENCY VS THE DOLLAR WILL BOOST THEIR PROFIT SINCE THEIR SALES PROCEEDS TO THE ROW ARE IN DOLLAR. - `18:08:22` --- note 6319/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00zir4zd", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "GEORGE SOROS REFLEXITIVITY THEORY: POSITIVE FEEDBACK LOOP: THE PARTICIPANTS VIEWS INFLUENCE THE COURSE OF EVENTS AND THE COURSE OF EVENTS INFLUENCE THE PARTICIPANTS VIEWS. THE STOCK MARKET IS A PERFECT EXAMPLE: A FAVORABLE VIEW OF THE MARKET MAKES IT EASY FOR COMPANIES TO ATTRACT CAPITAL BOTH FROM INVESTORS AND FROM BORROWERS. WHEN COMPANIES CAN MORE EASILY ATTRACT CAPITAL INVESTORS VIEW OF THE MARKET IMPROVES.", "created": 1780965710946, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6320/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00zi4dic", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "SOROS BOOM AND BUST THEORY: SOROS BELIEVE THAT STOCK PRICES MOVE IN A BOOM BUST FASHION. FIRST ITS A SELF-REINFORCING TREND BASED ON CHANGES IN FUNDAMENTALS. BECAUSE OF REFLEXIVITY, A POSITIVE FEEDBACK LOOP IS CREATED WHICH SET THINGS IN MOTION. BCS THE MOTION IS SELF REINFORCING, IT DOESNT STOP AT SOME EQUILIBRIUM. THE TREND COULD BE UPWARD OR DOWNWARD, IT DOESNT MATTER (BCS OF REFLEXIVITY HIGH PRICES WILL CAUSE EVEN HIGHER PRICES AND NEW HIGH WILL CAUSE EVEN HIGHER HIGHS IN THE UP TREND AND LOWER PRICES WILL CAUSE EVEN LOWER PRICES AND NEW LOW WILL CAUSE EVEN LOWER LOWER LOWS). SECONDLY, THE INVESTING COMMUNITY WILL REALIZE THAT THE MARKET HAS MOVED TOO FAR AWAY FROM WHAT THE FUNDAMENTALS IN THE ECONOMY SHOULD ALLOW FOR. THIRDLY, THIS CAUSES THE OPINION OF INVESTORS TO CHANGE, AND THE MARKET WILL SELF CORRECT WITH A TREND REVERSAL. GIVEN SOME TIME, REFLEXIVITY WILL CAUSE POSITIVE FEEDBACK LOOPS THAT ARE SELF REINFORCING, BUT THIS TIME IN THE OPPOSITE DIRECTION. THE FORCE IS TOO STRONG TO STOP AT ANY EQUILIBRIUM THAT FUNDAMENTALS WOULD SUGGEST. THE MARKET HAS NOW GONE THROUGH BOTH A BOOM AND A BUST. SO PRICES IN THE STOCK MARKET DO NO MOVE TOWARDS AN EQUILIBRIUM, BUT RATHER THEY MOVE AWAY FROM IT, UNTIL IT BECOMES OBVIOUS FROM FUNDAMENTAL FACTORS THAT THE BOOM OR BUST HAS GONE TOO FAR. THEN THE PRICE DIRECTION CHANGES.", "created": 1780965710945, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}

- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00ziy5kr", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "BOTH COVERED CALLS AND PROTECTIVE PUTS DEMONSTRATE THE NUNANCED BALANCE OF RISK AND REWARD IN OPTIONS TRADING. COVERED CALLS ALLOW YOU TO GENERATE INCOME ON YOUR EXISTING STOCK POSITIONS WITH THE TRADE OFF BEING THAT YOU MIGHT MISS OUT ON HIGHER PROFITS. ON THE FLIP SIDE PROTECTIVE PUTS PROVIDE A SAFETY NET AGAINST DOWNTURNS ENSURING THAT YOUR LOSSES ARE NOT CATASTROPHIC AT THE COST OF THE PREMIUM PAID FOR THIS INSURANCE.", "created": 1780965710933, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6333/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00zitnxu", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "2-PROTECTIVE PUTS: A PREDETERMINED EXIT STRATEGY THAT PROTECTS YOUR INITIAL INVESTMENT. PROTECTIVE PUTS STRATEGY SERVES AS AN INSURANCE POLICY FOR YOUR STOCK INVESTMENTS. IMAGINE YOU HAVE SEEN CONSIDERABLE GAINS ON YOUR SHARES OF COMPANY B NOW VALUED AT $150 EACH, WHILE OPTIMISTIC ABOUT THE FUTURE YOU'RE WAY OF UPCOMING MARKET VOLATILITY THAT COULD ERASE YOUR HARD EARNED GAINS. TO SAFEFUARD YOUR POSITION YOU BUY A PUT OPTION WITH A STRIKE PRICE OF $140 EXPIRING IN 3 MONTHS FOR A PREMIUM OF $5PER SHARE. THE PROTECTIVE PUT LIMITS YOUR POTENTIAL LOSS TO THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN THE STOCK'S CURRENT PRICE AND THE STRIKE PRICE OF THE PUT PLUS THE PREMIUM PAID. IF COMPANY B STOCK DROPS TO $120 YOU CAN EXERCISE YOUR OPTION TO SELL AT $140 SIGNIFICANTLY REDUCING YOUR LOSS HOWEVER IF THE PRICE REMAINS STABLE OR CLIMBS THE PREMIUM PAID FOR THE PUT CUTS INTO YOUR PROFITS ESSENTIALLY YOU ARE PAYING FOR PEACE OF MIND ENSURING THAT NO MATTER HOW THE MARKET SWINGS YOU HAVE A PREDETERMINED EXIT STRATEGY THAT PROTECTS YOUR INITIAL INVESTMENT.", "created": 1780965710932, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6334/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00zivdny", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "1- COVERED CALLS: WHEN AN INVESTOR OWNS A STOCK AND SELLS A CALL OPTION ON THE SAME STOCK. COVERED CALLS ARE AN EFFECTIVE WAY TO PROTECT AN INVESTMENT IN CASE OF DECLINE IN VALUE, THEY ALSO GIVE THE INVESTOR AN OPPORTUNITY TO MAKE MONEY ON THE PREMIUM. THE COVERED CALL STRATEGY IS A FAVORITE AMONG INVESTORS LOOKING TO GENERATE AN EXTRA STREAM OF INCOME STOCKS THEY ARE ALREADY HAPPY TO HOLD ONTO. HERE IS HOW IT WORKS: IMAGINE YOU OWN SHARES ON COMPANY A CURRENTLY TRADING AT $100 , YOU ARE BULLISH ON THE COMPANY'S LONG TERM PROSPECTS BUT DONT EXPECT SIGNIFICANT PRICE MOVEMENT IN THE SHORT TERM. TO CAPITALIZE ON THE STAGNATION YOU DECIDE TO WRITE OR SELL A CALL OPTION ON COMPANY A WITH A STRIKE PRICE OF $110. EXPIRING IN 1 MONTH FOR WHICH YOU RECEIVE A PREMIUM OF $3 PER SHARE. THE BEAUTY OF COVERED CALLS LIES IN THEIR ABILITY TO PROVIDE A CUSHION AGAINST A SLIGHT DIP IN THE STOCK PRICE THANKS TO THE PREMIUM YOU POCKET. IF COMPANY 1 STOCK STAYS UNDER $110 THE OPTION EXPIRES WORTHLESS AND YOU KEEP THE PREMIUM ADDING A BIT OF PADDING TO YOUR INVESTMENT HOWEVER IF THE STOCK SURGES PAST $110 YOU MIGHT HAVE TO SELL IT AT THIS PRICE POTENTIALLY MISSING OUT ON HIGHER PROFITS. ESSENTIALLY YOU ARE TRADING THE CHANCE FOR ADDITIONAL GAINS ABOVE THE STRIKE PRICE FOR AN IMMEDIATE RETURN.", "created": 1780965710931, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}

- `18:08:22` --- note 6352/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00zir2e1", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "WHAT IS OPTIONS TRADING EXACTLY? OPTIONS TRADING IS THE BUYING AND SELLING OF AN OPTION WHICH IS A CONTRACT THAT GIVES THE BEARER THE RIGHT BUT NOT THE OBLIGATION TO BUY OR SELL AN UNDERLYING ASSET FOR A SPECIFIC PRICE AND WITHIN A SPECIFIC TIME FRAME. OPTIONS TRADING AT ITS CORE IS ABOUT THE RIGHT TO MAKE A TRADE IN THE FUTURE AT A PRICE DECIDED TODAY. ITS LIKE HAVING A VOUCHER FOR A SALE PRICE ON YOUR FAVORITE GADGET THAT YOU CAN USE BEFORE IT EXPIRES WETHER THE PRICE OF THAT GADGET GOES UP OR DOWN.", "created": 1780965710912, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}

- `18:08:22` --- note 6357/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00zij79i", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "A SIDEWAYS AND NEUTRAL MARKET: NOTICE HOW PRICE IS MOVING SIDEWAYS MEANING YOU HAVE A NEAUTRAL BIAS IN YOUR MARKET DIRECTION. WHEN THE MARKET IS TRENDING SIDEWAYS IT MAKES ROUGHLY SAME HIGHS AND SAME LOWS, YOU CAN EASILY IDENTIFY THE EXTREME SWING HIGHS AND EXTREME SWING LOWS, YOU CAN ALSO EASILY PLACE A SUPPORT ZONE CONNECTING THE SWING LOWS AND A RESISTANCE ZONE CONNECTING THE SWING HIGHS. - `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00zixhp3", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "DEPRESSION IS COMPLETELY DIFFERENT PEOPLE SAY WELL OK IF A RECESSION IS 2 QUARTERS OF DECLINING GDP AND A DEPRESSION IS WORSE THAN A RECESSION THEN A DEPRESSION MUST BE 10 QUARTERS OF DECLINING GDP THAT'S NOT TRUE EITHER YOU CAN HAVE A GROWTH IN A DEPRESSION. NOW, THE PROBLEM WAS IT'S GROWING FROM A VERY LOW BASE, IN OTHER WORDS, UNEMPLOYMENT THE FIRST TERM OF REESEVELT ADMINISTRATION WENT FROM LIKE 22% TO 12% BUT IT WAS STILL 12% . 12% WAS AN IMPROVEMENT BUT NOTHING TO WRIE HOME ABOUT SO THE POINT BEING DEPRESSION DOES NOT MEAN CONTINUOUS DECLINING OF GDP GROWTH WHAT IT MEANS IS DEPRESSED GROWTH, GROWTH BELOW TREND. SO HERE WE HAVE THE SITUATION WHERE INFLATION IS COMING FROM THE SUPPLY SIDE THE FED CAN'T DO MUCH ABOUT IT BUT THE FED CAN DESTROY DEMAND BUT THAT WILL THROW THE US ECONOMY INTO A RECESSION.", "created": 1780965710872, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6393/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00ziukbu", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "EVERYTHING ARRIVES BY TRUCK AT THE END OF THE DAY, IT COULD COME BY BOAT OR TRAIN BUT SOMEWHERE IN THAT DELIVERY TRANSPORTATION CHANNELS THERE'S A TRUCK AND THEY RUN ON DIESEL AND WHEN THE PRICE OF DIESEL GOES UP THE PRICE OF EVERYTHING IN THE TRUCK GOES UP BCS YOU GOT TO FACTOR THE DELIVERY COST INTO THE COST AT THE COUNTER.", "created": 1780965710871, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6394/12122 >>> MACRO/RISK-RELEVANT <<< ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00zin0u7", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "WHAT CAUSE A FINANCIAL CRISIS? WHEN THE BANKS START REDUCING THEIR BALANCE SHEET THEN IT'S JUST A MATTER OF TIME WHERE SUDDENLY SOME MAJOR PLAYER GOES BANKRUPT THEY CAN'T MEET A COLLATERAL CALL OR A BANK GETS IN DISTRESS AND THERE'S A RUN ON THE BANK JUST LIKE WHAT HAPPENED IN 2008 WHEN MAJOR PLAYERS STARTED GOING BANKRUPT ONE AFTER THE OTHER.", "created": 1780965710870, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6395/12122  ---

- `18:08:22` --- note 6396/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00zis9gl", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "PRICE GAPS OFTEN OCCUR DUE TO NEWS RELEASES OUTSIDE OF REGULAR TRADING HOURS THAT CAUSE SWINGS IN PRICE", "created": 1780965710868, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6397/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00zis72x", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "WHEN YOU NOTICE PRICE DUMP THIS MEANS THERE IS MORE SELLERS THAN BUYERS AND PRICE FALLS TO MEET THAT EXCESS SUPPLY.", "created": 1780965710867, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6398/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00zibdm5", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "WHEN YOU NOTICE SIDEWAYS PRICE MOVEMENT THIS MEANS THERE IS AN EQUILIBRIUM BETWEEN BUYERS AND SELLERS.", "created": 1780965710866, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6399/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00zit1qw", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "WHEN YOU NOTICE PRICE PUMP THIS MEANS THERE ARE MORE BUYERS THAN SELLERS SO PRICE RISES TO MEET THAT DEMAND.", "created": 1780965710865, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6400/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00zih6fu", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "ALL 3 OF THESE TIME FRAMES NEED TO BE CONFLUENT AND TELLING YOUR TO TRADE IN THE SAME DIRECTION.", "created": 1780965710864, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6401/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00zishmv", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "3-YOUR LOWER INTRADAY TIME FRAME IS YOUR ENTRY TIME FRAME.", "created": 1780965710863, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6402/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00zio911", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "2-YOUR DAILY TIME FRAME TO GET YOUR MEDIUM TERM DIRECTIONAL BIAS.", "created": 1780965710862, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6403/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00zi9esh", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "1- YOUR WEEKLY TIME FRAME TO GET YOUR BIG PICTURE DIRECTIONAL BIAS.", "created": 1780965710861, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6404/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00ziolu7", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "SWING TRADING IS HOLDING POSITIONS FOR MORE THAN ONE DAY. THESE POSITIONS ARE OFTEN BOUGHT AND SOLD WITHIN A FEW DAYS, UP TO A FEW WEEKS. NOW FOR SWING TRADING YOU AGAIN NEED TIME FRAME CONFLUENCE FROM YOUR THREE CORE TIMES FRAMES:", "created": 1780965710860, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6405/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00ziofl3", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "NOW HERE IS THE KEY TO DAY TRADING: ALL THESE THREE TIMES FRAMES NEED TO HAVE PRICE ACTION THAT GIVES YOU THE SAME DIRECTIONAL BIAS AND ALL TELLING YOU TO TRADE IN THE SAME DIRECTION WHICH GIVES YOU THE MOST ACCURATE TRADE ENTRIES.", "created": 1780965710859, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6406/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00ziqrjs", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "3- YOUR VERY LOW TIME FRAME WHICH IS YOUR ENTRY TIME FRAME.", "created": 1780965710858, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6407/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00zijp2y", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "2- YOUR 4H TIME FRAME TO GET YOUR MEDIUM TERM DIRECTIONAL BIAS.", "created": 1780965710857, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6408/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00zijffc", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "1- YOUR DAILY TIME FRAME TO GET YOUR BIG PICTURE DIRECTIONAL BIAS.", "created": 1780965710856, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6409/12122 >>> MACRO/RISK-RELEVANT <<< ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00zik4qz", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "DAY TRADING IS BUYING AND SELLING AN ASSET WITHIN THE SAME TRADING DAY AND SESSION. THESE POSITIONS CAN LAST MINUTES TO HOURS BUT ALL POSITIONS ARE LIQUIDATED BEFORE THE END OF THE TRADING DAY AND SESSION. DAY TRADING INVOLVES COMBINING THE USAGE OF THESE 3 CORE TIME FRAMES:", "created": 1780965710855, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6410/12122 >>> MACRO/RISK-RELEVANT <<< ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00ziuzxw", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "RISK/REWARD RATIO ALLOWS YOU TO MEASURE WHAT YOU CAN POSSIBLY GAIN FOR EVERY DOLLAR YOU RISK ON AN INVESTMENT. WHAT YOU RISK SHOULD BE AT MINIMUM BE EQUAL TO WHAT YOU CAN GAIN. MEANING A RISK/REWARD RATIO OF 1:1.", "created": 1780965710854, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6411/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00ziifxu", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "DEAD CAT BOUNCE: WHEN A STOCK IS ON THE DECLINE, IN A DOWNTREND AND IN A BEARISH MARKET, YOU MIGHT NOTICE A PULLBACK OR SLIGHT UPWARDS BOUNCE AND RECOVERY, BEFORE CONTINUING DOWNWARDS. DEAD CAT BOUNCES ARE SMALL PULLBACKS THAT OCCUR WITHIN THE LARGER MOVING DOWNTREND. THE REASON DEAD CAT BOUNCES FORM DUE TO SHORT SELLERS TAKING PROFIT OR FROM VALUE BUYERS TRYING TO BUY INTO THE STOCK BUT OVERALL THE SELLING PRESSURE IS TOO STRONG FOR ANY KIND OF TRUE TREND CHANGE TO OCCUR AND THE DOWNTREND JUST CONTINUES ON.", "created": 1780965710853, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6412/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00ziywl4", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "TECHNICAL ANALYSIS IS LOOKING AT PAST PRICE MOVEMENT AND MARKET DATA, IDENTIFYING PATTERNS AND TRENDS, AND USING IT ALL TO HELP MAKE PREDICTIONS OF FUTURE PRICE MOVEMENT AND FUTURE MARKET DIRECTION.", "created": 1780965710852, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6413/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00zi15yy", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "PUT OPTION: GIVES YOU THE RIGHT TO SELL A STOCK AT A SET PRICE. IF THAT CONTRACT HAS A STRIKE PRICE OF $50 AND THE STOCK DECREASES TO $25, THE OPTIONS CONTRACT ALLOWS YOU TO STILL SELL THE STOCK FOR $50 WHICH IS ABOVE THE CURRENT $25 MARKET PRICE.", "created": 1780965710851, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6414/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00zijx30", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "CALL OPTION GIVES YOU THE RIGHT TO BUY A STOCK AT A SET PRICE SO IF THAT CONTRACT HAS A STRIKE PRICE OF $100 AND THE STOCK INCREASES TO $150 THE OPTION CONTRACT ALLOWS YOU TO STILL BUY THE STOCK FOR $100 WHICH IS BELOW THE CURRENT $150 MARKET PRICE.", "created": 1780965710850, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6415/12122 >>> MACRO/RISK-RELEVANT <<< ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00ziefog", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "OPTIONS TRADING: OPTIONS ARE FINANCIAL INSTRUMENTS OR CONTRACTS THAT GIVE THE BUYER THE RIGHT TO BUY OR SELL AN ASSET AT A SET PRICE ANY TIME UP UNTIL THE CONTRACT EXPIRES. THE BUYER IS NOT OBLIGATED BUT HAS THE OPTION TO DO SO.", "created": 1780965710849, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6416/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00zi4h3r", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "COMPOUND INTEREST IS WHEN YOU EARN INTEREST ON THE PRINCIPAL MONEY YOU HAVE, BUT THEN GOING FORWARD, ALSO EARNING INTEREST ON THE NEW INTEREST PAYMENT YOU RECEIVED. FOR EX: IF YOU HAVE $100 AND EARN 5% INTEREST PER MONTH, AFTER 1 MONTH YOU WILL HAVE $105 THEN THE NEXT MONTH YOU WILL EARN 5% INTEREST ON $105 WHICH MEANS YOU WILL HAVE $110.25 AFTER MONTH 2. OVER TIME THIS CREATES A COMPOUNDING SNOWBALLING EFFECT WHERE YOUR MONEY GROWS EXPONENTIALLY.", "created": 1780965710848, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6417/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00zijxjn", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "DARK POOLS ARE PRIVATE EXCHANGES AND FORUMS USED BY LARGE INSTITUTIONAL INVESTORS TO BUY AND SELL LARGE BLOCK ORDERS, AND ALOOWS THEM TO HIDE AND MASK THEIR MOVES FROM THE GENERAL PUBLIC TO AVOID IMPACTING THE LARGER MARKET. DARK POOLS ARE PERFECTLY LEGAL AND REGULATED BY THE SEC.", "created": 1780965710847, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6418/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00zipmkc", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "DOW JONES INDUSTRIAL AVERAGE: THE DOW JONES IS A STOCK MARKET INDEX THAT TRACKS 30 LARGE BLUE CHIPS STOCKS FROM THE NEW YORK STOCK EXCHANGE AND NASDAQ. THE INDEX WAS CREATED IN 1896 BY CHARLES DOW TO ACT AS A PROXY FOR THE HEALTH OF THE WIDER US ECONOMY.", "created": 1780965710846, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6419/12122 >>> MACRO/RISK-RELEVANT <<< ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00zipn5c", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "S&P500 IS A MARKET CAPITALIZATION WEIGHTED INDEX THAT TRACKS THE PERFORMANCE OF 500 OF THE LARGEST COMPANIES LISTED IN THE US STOCK EXCHANGES. THIS INDEX WAS LAUNCHED IN 1957 BY CREDIT RATING AGENCY STANDAD AND POOR'S.", "created": 1780965710845, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6420/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00zizc4g", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "OVER THE COUNTER SECURITIES (OTC) US NEW LOWS ON WEEKLY SHOWS CAPITULATION.", "created": 1780965710844, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6421/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00zi27bt", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "PIP: IN FOREX , A PIP STANDS FOR PERCENTAGE IN POINT, WHICH REPRESENTA UNIT OF CHANGE IN AN EXCHANGE RATE OF A CURRENCY PAIR. MAJOR CURRENCY PAIRS ARE PRICED TO FOUR DECIMAL PLACES AND A PIP IS 0.00001", "created": 1780965710843, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6422/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00zimzsd", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "CURRENCY PAIRS: CURRENCIES ARE QUOTED AS PAIRS, MEANING IT IS THE VALUE OF ONE CURRENCY AGAINST ANOTHER CURRENCY.", "created": 1780965710842, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6423/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00zioetp", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "FOREX OR FOREIGN EXCHANGE TRADING IS THE ACT OF TRADING INTERNATIONAL CURRENCIES. THE FOREX MARKET IS ONE OF THE MOST WIDELY TRADED MARKETS IN THE WORLD WITH DAILY TRADING VOLUME OF OVER 6 TRILLION DOLLARS.", "created": 1780965710841, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6424/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00ziv602", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "COMMODITIES ARE OFTEN TRADED THROUGH FUTURES CONTRACTS, BUT YOU CAN ALSO INVEST INTO STOCKS OF COMPANIES THAT PRODUCE COMMODITIES, OR INVEST INTO ETFS AND MUTUAL FUNDS THAT HAVE COMMODITY EXPOSURE.", "created": 1780965710840, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6425/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00zirg3o", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "SOFT COMMODITIES ARE GROWN AND HARVESTED SUCH AS LUMBER, WHEAT, COFFEE, AND CATTLE.", "created": 1780965710839, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6426/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00ziacko", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "HARD COMMODITIES ARE NATURAL RESOURCES EXTRACTED OR MINED FROM THE EARTH SUCH AS COPPER, NATURAL GAS, OIL AND GOLD.", "created": 1780965710838, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6427/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00zir97e", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "COMMODITIES: ARE NATURAL MATERIALS SUCH AS METALS, GOLD, CORN, OIL, THAT HUMANS PROCESS AND USE FOR THE ECONOMY.", "created": 1780965710837, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6428/12122 >>> MACRO/RISK-RELEVANT <<< ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00zifsbu", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "FUTURES TRADING: FUTURES ARE A LOT LIKE OPTIONS EXCEPT THE CONTRACT ACTUALLY OBLIGATES YOU TO BUY OR SELL THE ASSET FOR A SET PRICE ON A SET FUTURE DATE. FUTURES CONTRACTS ARE USED TO SPECULATE ON THE FUTURE PRICE MOVEMENTS OF AN ASSET OR TO HEDGE RISKS.", "created": 1780965710836, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6429/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00zigdq7", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "RECESSION IS TRADITIONALLY DEFINED AS 2 CONSECUTIVE QUARTERS OF NEGATIVE GDP. DURING RECESSION STOCKS TEND TO TREND DOWNWARDS DUE TO NEGATIVE MARKET SENTIMENT. RECESSIONS DO ALSO PRESENT GREAT BUYING OPPORTUNITIES BCS IF YOU LOOK BACK AT MANY OF THE PREVIOUS RECESSIONS, THEY ARE OFTEN FOLLOWED BY SOME MASSIVE BULL RUN AFTERWARDS. THIS MEANS INVESTORS CAN TAKE ADVANTAGE OF RECESSIONS AND BUY GREAT COMPANIES AT A HEAVY DISCOUNT.", "created": 1780965710835, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6430/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00ziveu8", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "INTEREST RATES AND THE FED: WHEN THE FED IS TRYING TO COOL DOWN THE ECONOMY, THEY WILL RAISE INTEREST RATES, WHICH IN THEORY SHOULD CAUSE THE STOCK MARKET TO GO DOWN, BCS MONEY AND BORROWING IS MORE EXPENSIVE. WHEN THE FEDERAL RESERVE WANTS TO STIMULATE THE ECONOMY, THEY WILL CUT INTEREST RATES, WHICH IN THEORY SHOULD CAUSE THE STOCK MARKET TO GO UP BECAUSE MONEY AND BORROWING IS CHEAPER. THIS MEANS THE STOCK MARKET AND INTEREST RATES HAVE A NEGATIVE OR INVERSE CORRELATION.", "created": 1780965710834, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6431/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00zi5u45", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "BONDS ARE A TYPE OF SECURITY ISSUED BY GOVS AND CORPS WHEN THEY ARE LOOKING TO RAISE MONEY. WHEN YOU BUY A BOND, YOU ARE ESSENTIALLY GIVING A LOAN TO THE ISSUER. BONDS DIFFER FROM STOCKS BCS YOU DONT OWN ANYTHING THEY JUST ACT AS AN INCOME STREAM.", "created": 1780965710833, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6432/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00zipj84", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "REAL ESTATE INVESTMENT TRUST (REIT): REITS ARE COMPANIES THAT OWN AND OPERATE INCOME PRODUCING REAL ESTATE. SUCH AS: HOTELS, APARTMENTS, RESORTS, WAREHOUSES AND COMMERCIAL FORESTS. INVESTING IN REITS GIVE YOU EXPOSURE INTO REAL ESTATE INVESTMENTS WITHOUT HAVING TO BUY REAL ESTATE ASSETS DIRECTLY.", "created": 1780965710832, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6433/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00zijqbg", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "INDEX FUND IS A TYPE OF MUTUAL FUND OR EXCHANGE TRADED FUND THAT IS CONSTRUCTED IN A WAY TO MATCH AND TRACK MARKET INDEX'S SUCH AS THE S&P500. THE BASE LINE GOAL OF AN INDEX FUND IS TO REPLICATE THE PERFORMANCE OF THE UNDERLINING MARKET INDEX ITS MIMICKING.", "created": 1780965710831, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6434/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00zisjx6", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "MUTUAL FUND IS A TYPE OF INVESTMENT WHERE MONEY IS POOLED TOGETHER FROM VARIOUS INVESTORS TO THEN INVEST IN STOCKS, BONDS, AND OTHER FINANCIAL ASSETS. MUTUAL FUNDS ARE MANAGED BY PROFESSIONAL MONEY MANAGERS WHICH COMES WITH ITS OWN SET OF FEES.", "created": 1780965710830, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6435/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00zi6ddh", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "INVERSE ETF OR INVERSE EXCHANGE TRADED FUND: INVESTING IN AN INVERSE ETF ALLWS YOU TO PROFIT FROM THE PRICE DECLINE OF A BENCHMARK INDEX SUCH AS THE S&P500, INSTEAD OF SHORTING INDIVIDUAL STOCKS. IN SIMPLIFIED TERMS: IF YOU SEE THE S&P500 GO DOWN BY 2% YOU SHOULD SEE THE PRICE OF YOUR INVERSE ETF GO UP BY 2%.", "created": 1780965710829, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6436/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00zie1kr", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "ETF OR EXCHANGE TRADED FUND: AN ETF IS AN INVESTMENT FUND THAT INVESTS IN A BASKET OF STOCKS , BONDS OR OTHER FINANCIAL ASSETS, MEANING WHEN YOU BUY AN ETF, YOU ARE INVESTING IN MANY DIFFERENT SECURITIES ALL AT ONCE ALLOWING YOU TO BE MORE DIVERSIFIED.", "created": 1780965710828, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6437/12122 >>> MACRO/RISK-RELEVANT <<< ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00ziuonb", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "OVER THE COUNTER SECURITIES (OTC) ARE SECURITIES NOT LISTED ON MAJOR STOCK EXCHANGES AND REQUIRE BROKER-DEALER NETWORK TO BUY AND SELL THEM. THESE COMPANIES DON'T QUALIFY OR MEET STANDARDS TO BE ABLE TO TRADE ON MAJOR STOCK EXCHANGES. OVER THE COUNTER SECURITIES TEND TO BE LESS LIQUID (THAT'S WHY THEY ARE A GREAT BAROMETER TO GAUGE LIQUIDITY IN THE MARKET) AND ARE ALSO LESS REGULATED WHICH BRINGS MORE POTENTIAL RISKS.", "created": 1780965710827, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6438/12122 >>> MACRO/RISK-RELEVANT <<< ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00zi4wgf", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "PENNY STOCKS ARE STOCKS FROM SMALL COMPANIS WITH A SHARE PRICE THAT IS LESS THAN $5. THEY HAVE LOWER TRADING VOLUME AND LOWER LIQUIDITY. WHEN YOU TRY TO BUY OR SELL A PENNY STOCK, IT WILL OFTEN TAKE LONGER FOR YOUR POSITIONS TO BE FILLED AND THEY MIGHT NOT EVEN BE FILLED AT ALL DUE TO LOW VOLUME AND LOW LIQUIDITY.", "created": 1780965710826, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6439/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00zir32g", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "BLUE CHIP STOCKS ARE STOCKS FROM LARGE CORPORATIONS THAT ARE SEEN AS SAFE, STABLE AND REPUTABLE, AND THAT HAVE BEEN AROUND FOR A LONGER PERIOD OF TIME. THEY HAVE MANY YEARS OF SOLID EARNINGS AND OFTEN PAY DIVIDENDS. EX: MICROSOFT, APPLE, COCA COLA.", "created": 1780965710825, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6440/12122 >>> MACRO/RISK-RELEVANT <<< ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00zi2mb6", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "LIQUIDITY IS HOW FAST AND EASILY YOU CAN BUY OR SELL AN ASSET WITHOUT IT SIGNIFICANTLY IMPACTING THE STOCK PRICE.", "created": 1780965710824, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6441/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00zi3j8l", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "WHEN THE STOCK MARKET PERCEPTION IS WAY HIGH AND THE REAL ECONOMY IS WAY DOWN. NOW THE QUESTION IS WHEN DOES THAT COVERGE BCS EVENTUALLY THEY WILL. REALITY ALWAYS WINS BUT NOT RIGHT AWAY. THE PERCEPTION, THE BUBBLE, THE WISHFUL THINKING CAN PERSIST FOR A PERIOD OF TIME. SO YOU HAVE ABIDE BY YOUR TIME, YOU HAVE TO BE PATIENT, KEEP SOME CASH, BE READY FOR SEVERE CORRECTIONS.", "created": 1780965710823, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6442/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00zisszt", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "SHORT SQUEEZE: WHEN A STOCK RISES SIGNIFICANTLY DUE TO HEAVY BUYING PRESENCE SHORT SELLERS WHO ARE HOLDING SHORT POSITIONS ON THAT SAME STOCK ARE FORCED TO COVER THOSE SHORTS AND PURCHASE THE STOCK IN ORDER TO LIMIT FURTHER LOSSES. THE DOUBLE ACTION OF LONG BUYERS BUYING UP THE STOCK AND SHORT SELLERS BUYING UP THE STOCK TRIGGERS AN EVEN GREATER EXPLOSIVE MOVE UPWARDS. EX: GAME STOP. THE DRASTIC MOVES UPWARDS AFTER A SHORT SQUEEZE USUALLY DON'T SUSTAIN AND PRICE OFTEN COMES BACK DOWN TO EARTH AFTERWARDS BCS THE DRIVING FORCE BEHIND THE INITIAL MASSIVE MOVE UPWARDS WAS BASED ON IRRATIONAL FACTORS AND NOT FUNDAMENTAL FACTORS. PRICE ALWAYS COME BACK DOWN AFTERWARDS AND WOULDNT BE ABLE TO SUSTAIN THE HIGHS AS THE COMPANY'S FUNDAMENTALS DOESNT SUPPORT THE INSANELY EXPENSIVE PRICE OF THE ASSET.", "created": 1780965710822, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6443/12122 >>> MACRO/RISK-RELEVANT <<< ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00zik1t9", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "SHORT INTEREST: IS THE TOTAL NUMBER OF SHARES OF A STOCK THAT HAVE BEEN SOLD SHORT AND THAT HAVENT BEEN COVERED YET. AN INCREASE IN SHORT INTEREST SIGNALS INVESTORS ARE GETTING MORE BEARISH. A DECREASE IN SHORT INTEREST SIGNALS INVESTORS ARE GETTING MORE BULLISH. USE A SITE LIKE MARKETWATCH AND FIND A COMPANY'S SHORT INTEREST, LOOK AT THE FLOATED SHORT PERCENTAGE, THE HIGHER THIS PERCENTAGE IS THE MORE PESSIMICTIC INVESTORS ARE TOWARDS THE STOCK AND THE STOCK OVERALL IS DEEMED A MORE RISKY PLAY.", "created": 1780965710821, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6444/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00ziyt3l", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "STOCK BUYBACK: IS WHEN A COMPANY USES ITS CHASH TO REPURCHASE ITS OWN OUTSTANDING SHARES, IN ORDER TO REDUCE THE NUMBER OF SHARES ON THE MARKET. THIS IN TURN MEANS THE REMAINING SHARES ON THE MARKET INCREASE IN VALUE, AND THEORETICALLY SHOULD LEAD TO AN INCREASE IN THE COMPANY'S STOCK PRICE. WARREN BUFFETT FAMOUSLY LOADED UP ON APPLE STOCK DUE TO HIS SUPPORT OF THEIR AGGRESSIVE SHARE BUYBACK PROGRAM WHICH HAS RESULTED IN THE METEORIC RISE OF APPLE'S STOCK EVER SINCE AND ITS BIRKSHIRE HATHWAYS LARGEST STOCK HOLDINGS.", "created": 1780965710820, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6445/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00zixyqq", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "A STOCK SPLIT IS WHEN A COMPANY SPLITS ITS STOCK, WHICH INCREASES THE NUMBER OF SHARES OUTSTANDING, BUT AS A RESULT EACH INDIVIDUAL SHARE IS DEVALUED. FOR EX: IF THERE IS A 2 FOR 1 SPLIT, EVERY SHARE YOU HAVE IS NOW DOUBLED, BUT EACH ONE OF THOSE SHARES IS WORTH HALF AS MUCH. THIS IS OFTEN DONE TO MAKE EACH SHARE PRICE LOWER TO APPEAL TO NEW INVESTORS SO THAT THEY'LL BUY IN. YOU CAN USE A STOCK SPLIT CALENDARE LIKE THE ONE ON THE NASDAQ WEBSITE TO TRACK UPCOMING SPLITS.", "created": 1780965710819, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6446/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00zifdo7", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "INITIAL PUBLIC OFFERING (IPO): AN IPO IS WHEN A PRIVATE COMPANY GOES PUBLIC, AND STARTS SELLING ITS SHARES ON A STOCK EXCHANGE WHERE THE GENERAL PUBLIC CAN PURCHASE. THERE ARE ALWAYS IPOS TO LOOK OUT FOR. YOU CAN USE AN IPO CALENDAR LIKE THE ONE ON THE NASDAQ WEBSITE TO TRACK UPCOMING IPOS OR RECENT IPOS.", "created": 1780965710818, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6447/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00zi8w07", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "DIVIDENDS ARE PERIODIC PAYMENTS MADE TO YOU FROM COMPANIES YOU OWN STOCKS IN, USUALLY TAKEN FROM THE COMPANY'S PROFITS. NOT ALL STOCKS PAY DIVIDENDS. WHEN LOOKING AT DIVIDEND PAYING STOCKS, IDENTIFY THE DIVIDEND PER SHARE, DIVIDEND YIELD, AND THE DIVIDEND PAYOUT RATIO. COMPANIES THAT PROVIDE CONSISTENT DIVIDEND PAYMENTS THAT ALSO INCREASE OVERTIME ARE SEEN AS COMPANIES THAT ARE HEALTHY AND GAINING IN STRENGTH. COMPANIES THAT PROVIDE INCONSISTENT DIVIDEND PAYMENTS OR DIVIDEND PAYMENTS THAT DECREASE OVERTIMEARE SEEN AS WEAKENING COMPANIES. FROM THE NASDAQ WEBSITE YOU CAN FIND ALL THE DIVIDEND INFO YOU NEED.", "created": 1780965710817, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6448/12122 >>> MACRO/RISK-RELEVANT <<< ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00zi0yyp", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "EARNINGS REPORTS ARE QUARTERLY FINANCIAL STATEMENTS ISSUED BY PUBLICLY TRADED COMPANIES, THAT INVESTORS USE TO GAUGE COMPANY HEALTH, PERFORMANCE AND WETHER THEY ARE GOOD ONVESTMENTS OR NOT. EARNINGS REPORTS INCLUDE AN INCOME STATEMENT, A BALANCE SHEET AND A CASH FLOW STATEMENT. BEFORE EACH EARNING REPORT, THERE IS AN ESTIMATED EPS, AND WHEN THE EARNINGS REPORT IS ACTUALLY RELEASE, THE FINAL EPS WILL EITHER MEET, BEAT OR MISS THE ESTIMATED EPS WHICH LEAD TO HIGHER VOLATILITY AND SWINGS OF PRICE. FROM GOOGLE SEARCH YOU WILL FIND ALL THE EARNINGS CALLS. ON THE NASDAQ WEBSITE YOU CAN FIND THE DATE OF THE NEXT EARNINGS CALL.", "created": 1780965710816, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6449/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00zitfht", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "P/E RATIO OR PRICE TO EARNINGS RATIO: TO CALCULATE A COMPANY P/E RATIO, YOU TAKE A COMPANY CURRENT PRICE PER SHARE AND DIVIDE IT BY THE EARNINGS PER SHARE OR EPS. P/E RATIO IS A METHOD USED TO GAUGE WETHER THE PRICE OF A STOCK IS ACCURATELY OR FAIRLY PRICED AGAINST ITS EARNINGS POTENTIAL. TRADITIONALLY SPEAKING, THE HIGHER THE P/E RATIO, THE MORE OVERVALUED THE COMPANY IS, WHERE IN CONTRAST, THE LOWER THE P/E RATIO, THE MORE UNDERVALUED THE COMPANY IS. FROM THE NASDAQ WEBSITE YOU CAN EASILY FIND ANY COMPANY'S.", "created": 1780965710815, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6450/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00zia4g9", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "EARNINGS PER SHARE (EPS) ARE CALCULATED BY TAKING A COMPANY'S NET INCOME SUBSTRACT FROM THAT PREFERRED DIVIDENDS THEN DIVIDE THAT AMOUNT BY THE AVERAGE NUMBER OF OUTSTANDING SHARES. EPS IS USED TO GAUGE HOW MUCH MONEY A COMPANY MAKES FOR EACH ONE OF ITS SHARES OF STOCK IN SIMPLIFIED TERMS INVESTORS USE EPS TO MEASURE COMPANY'S PROFITIBILITY. FROM THE NASDAQ WEBSITE YOU CAN EASILY FIND ANY COMPANY'S EPS.", "created": 1780965710814, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6451/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00zi218b", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "MARKET CAP: MARKET CAPITALIZATION IS THE TOTAL VALUE OF A COMPANY'S SHARES. SIMPLY TAKE A COMPANY'S OUTSTANDING SHARES AND MULTIPLY IT BY THE CURRENT MARKET PRICE PER SHARE TO GET YOUR MARKET CAPITALIZATION.", "created": 1780965710813, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6452/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00zig77u", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "USE THE VIX AS A WAY TO GAUGE MARKET SENTIMENT AND YOUR TRADING DIRECTIONAL BIAS.", "created": 1780965710812, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6453/12122  ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00zi6a98", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "VIX ALSO KNOWN AS THE FEAR INDEX, MEASURES THE IMPLIED VOLATILITY OF THE S7P500 AND THE MARKETS EXPECTED VOLATILITY OVER THE COMING 30 DAYS. THE VIX HAS A NEGATIVE CORRELATION OR OVERSE RELATIONSHIP TO THE S&P500. MEANING WHEN YOU SEE THE VIX RISE, THIS SIGNALS FEAR IS RISING AND MARKET CONFIDENCE IS DECLINING, WHICH OFTEN RESULTS IN THE OVERALL STOCK MARKET TO TREND DOWNWARDS. IF THE VIX FALLS, THIS SIGNALS FEAR IS DECLINING AND MARKET CONFIDENCE IS INCREASING WHICH OFTEN RESULTS IN THE OVERALL STOCK MARKET TO TURN UPWARDS.", "created": 1780965710811, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}
- `18:08:22` --- note 6454/12122 >>> MACRO/RISK-RELEVANT <<< ---
- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00zihee2", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "VOLATILITY IS THE SWINGING OF A STOCK PRICE UP AND DOWN. WHEN YOU SEE SMALLER AND LESS FREQUENT SWINGS OF PRICE THIS SIGNALS LOWER VOLATILITY. WHEN YOU SEE LARGER AND MORE FREQUENT SWINGS OF PRICE THIS SIGNALS HIGHER VOLATILITY. HIGH VOLATILITY MEANS THERE IS MORE RISK FOR YOUR TRADES BUT ALSO MORE REWARD.", "created": 1780965710810, "pinned": false, "source": "3rd book.docx"}

- `18:08:22`   {"id": "nmq5x00zh75jx", "cat": "philosophy", "text": "THE GEORGE SOROS TRADE: THE SPECULATION PROCESS GOES LIKE THIS: AN INVESTOR DEPOSITS A SECURITY OF 1 BILLION US DOLLARS WITH A BANK SOMEWHERE IN THE WORLD. WHEN THE EXCHANGE RATE OF THE BAHT TO THE DOLLAR HAS FALLEN, FOR EXAMPLE BY 30% THE INVESTOR THEN BUYS BACK THE 25 BILLION BAHT WITH ONLY 700 MILLION US DOLLARS, THEREBY REDEEMING HIS LOAN.
